g.text: One compute pass, from the Render thread down to warps on the GPU.
Records the pass and its parameter struct: what it reads and writes, as SRV or UAV
Setup is finished. From here RDG compiles the graph and runs it
Cull unused passes, compute lifetimes, allocate / alias transient memory, plan barriers
Your lambda runs: set pipeline, bind parameters, Dispatch
RHI commands become D3D12 / Vulkan / Metal calls, submitted to the driver
Command processor reads Dispatch(X, Y, Z)
The GPU front end picks up the dispatch from the command buffer
Thread groups handed to SMs / CUs
A whole group stays on one SM, if it has room (registers, shared memory, warp slots)
The scheduler swaps stalled warps for ready ones
